# Legacy terrain fingerprints

`extensive_lakes_legacy.json` contains generated SHA-256 regression values from
TerraForest's existing native terrain: seeds 42 and 1703, generator IDs 1–31,
cave/lake catalogs and 195 sampled heights per field. Captured with the original
terrain DLL before the extensive-lake changes, using `tests/extensive_lakes.gd`.
The capture receipt is `reports/checks/20261127T150539502009Z/run.json`.

Original project test data, AI-assisted tooling, 2026-11-27. No external source
material or reference assets. Dedicated under CC0-1.0.
